items.text: Import export work covers sourcing, documentation, shipping, customs clearance and payment handling, and the safe way in is to learn the document trail through a job or a small trial shipment, verify every partner and never send money to someone you cannot check.
Learn documents and compliance, work with a freight forwarder or customs professional, test one product with a small order and verify customers and suppliers through official channels.
Check official guidance and use banking channels, not personal transfers to strangers.
